0fedae99274b701f35a6.en: Division shares into equal groups. 12 ÷ 3 means 12 shared into 3 groups.
0fedae99274b701f35a6.id: Pembagian membagi menjadi kelompok yang sama banyak. 12 ÷ 3 berarti 12 dibagi menjadi 3 kelompok.

b37ff462a3b9a3e03e3c.en: Use times tables to divide. 3 × 4 = 12, so 12 ÷ 3 = 4.

c83cec788eb80469a23d.en: Sometimes some are left over. This is called the remainder.
c83cec788eb80469a23d.id: Kadang ada yang tersisa. Ini disebut sisa (remainder).

a88c0e2ba12e81a5dd24.en: 3 groups of 4 use 12 cookies. 2 cookies are left over.
a88c0e2ba12e81a5dd24.id: 3 kelompok berisi 4 memakai 12 kue kering. 2 kue kering tersisa.

52990b784353533974d1.en: 4 × 5 = 20, and 23 - 20 = 3. So the answer is 5 remainder 3.
